UnitStatement: A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires SOURCE_PDF_NAME.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires PAGE_NUM.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires TILE_ID.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires SOURCE_RASTER_PATH.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires TILE_IMAGE_PATH.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires OUTPUT_PATH.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires MODE with value basic or detailed.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief requires TILE_GEOMETRY with tile_grid, body_box_px, body_exclusions, read_box_px, emit_box_px, overlap_px, and mini_grid.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief may include ALLOW_REFERENCE_SHEETS.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief may include SCOPE_FILE.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief may include BASIC_REFERENCE_RUN.
A pandid-valve-symbol-instance brief may include BASIC_COUNTS_CSV.
The brief must include the canonical output template rendered by build_pandid_valve_tile_brief.py.
Text-only observations must be rejected as rows.
Every emitted row must have integer page-global center and bounding-box coordinates.
Every counted row must have a valve symbol_class, count_include=true, and symbol_confidence of medium or high.
visible_tag_text is only for tag_status=true_tag; line/spec text belongs in nearby_line_text.
Tag-profile conflicts are review warnings only and do not delete rows or alter symbol counts.
For SUCCESS, finding_count must equal the number of emitted rows.
The skill extracts visible P&ID valve body symbol instances from one prepared tile.
A row may exist only after an isolated symbol crop has been classified as a valve class.
Tag profiles never delete rows for this skill.
The tile image is used only to detect plausible valve glyphs whose page-global center falls inside the emit box.
Each plausible glyph must be reasoned from a tight isolated crop that excludes nearby line/spec/tag text as much as practical.
The skill emits one row per crop classified as a valve class.
count_include=true is used only for valve classes with medium or high symbol_confidence.
Text-only rows must not be emitted.
Nearby line/spec text may populate nearby_line_text with tag_status=line_spec_only or ambiguous only after a valve row exists.
visible_tag_text is used only for actual valve/control-loop tags with tag_status=true_tag.
Reference or legend sheets return NO_FINDINGS_REFERENCE unless the brief explicitly allows them.
The output file is a markdown stub using valve_schema_version: symbol_instance_v1 and canonical table columns from valve_stub_layout.py.
Required row evidence includes page-global center_x_px and center_y_px.
Required row evidence includes page-global bbox_*_px.
Required row evidence includes symbol_crop_path.
Required row evidence includes symbol_class.
Required row evidence includes symbol_confidence.
Required row evidence includes count_include.
Required row evidence includes review_status.
Required row evidence includes review_reason.
Valid valve classes are manual_block, manual_throttle, check, control, esd_block, relief, and specialty_valve.
build_pandid_valve_tile_brief.py is a preferred deterministic tool.
validate_valve_tile_stub_format.py is a preferred deterministic tool.
assemble_valve_candidates_csv.py is a preferred deterministic tool.
assign_valve_symbol_geometry_duplicates.py is a preferred deterministic tool.
aggregate_valve_counts.py is a preferred deterministic tool.
flag_duplicate_valve_candidates.py is a preferred deterministic tool.
Inferring a counted valve row from text patterns alone is disallowed.
Mutating raw candidate CSVs to encode later human review decisions is disallowed.
Auto-migrating legacy pandid-valve-tile stubs into symbol_instance_v1 is disallowed.
